CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that a special meeting of the City Council is to take place at City Hall,
340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 7:30 a.m. on Tuesday, December 21,
2010 for the purpose of considering a resolution providing for the appointment to the offices of this
City that were to be elected on Tuesday, March 8, 2011. The agenda for the special meeting with
the precise items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by City Clerk on December 15, 2010.

  December 21, 2010
  7:30 A.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council must
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

TO:  JOSEPH HOEFGEN, CITY MANAGER

FROM:  JUDY SMITH, ASSISTANT CITY MANAGER

SUBJECT:  RESOLUTION R10-29; PROVIDING FOR THE APPOINTMENT TO THE
  OFFICES OF THIS CITY THAT WERE TO BE ELECTED ON TUESDAY
  MARCH 8, 2011

The Issue

Shall the City Council adopt Resolution R10-29 to appoint the persons nominated for Member of
the City Council (3) and cancel the election previously scheduled to be held Tuesday, March 8,
2011?

Analysis and Findings

On October 12, 2010 at a regular City Council meeting, the Council adopted Resolution R10-20
calling for an election to be held in the City on Tuesday, March 8, 2011. A notice announcing that
the City would conduct an election on Tuesday March 8, 2011 was posted on October 21st and
published in the Peninsula News on October 21st and published in the Chinese Daily News on
October 24, 2010 in accordance with provisions of the Election Code. Prior to these actions, the
City announced in the October issue of the City newsletter, which is delivered to each home and
business in the City, that the City would hold an election and provided information on the
nomination period and how nomination papers could be obtained.

The nomination period for the March 8, 2011 election began Monday, November 15, 2010. As of
the close of the nomination period on Friday, December 10, 2010, the number of persons nominated
by qualified electors of the City was equal to the number of offices available. The persons
nominated are:

  Member of the City Council
  Rosemary Humphrey
  Ellen Perkins
  John Rea

As required by Election Code Section 10299, the City posted and published a notice that there were
not more candidates than offices to be elected and that the City Council would meet on Tuesday,
December 21, 2010 to consider the options available to them.

In the current circumstances, where the number of candidates nominated is equal to the number of
offices available, the applicable options available to the Council under the Election Code are to

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
DECEMBER 21, 2010
  3
 appoint those nominated and cancel the election by adopting the attached resolution OR to order
that the election be held as scheduled.

There is significant expense in conducting an election. The City had budgeted $27,500 to conduct
the March 2011 election. The net cost to the City would have been less than that amount due to the
fact the City of Los Angeles would have shared in part of eligible expenses since the Council agreed
to consolidate our election with the City’s election of members of the Community College District
Board. The Notice of Insufficient Candidates has been provided to the City of Los Angeles and
they will conduct their own election within Palos Verdes Estates, if the March 8, 2011 General
Municipal election is canceled.

If the City Council adopts Resolution R10-29, the persons appointed will serve as if elected. The
persons appointed will assume office in March, 2011 and the City Council will reorganize at that
time.

Alternatives Available to the City Council

  1.  Adopt Resolution R10-29.
  2.  Decline to adopt the Resolution and order that the election be held.

Recommendation

It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R10-29 appointing to the office the
persons nominated for Member of the City Council (3) and cancel the election scheduled to be held
Tuesday, March 8, 2011.

Fiscal Impact

The recommendation to cancel the election is provided to the Council because the cost to conduct
an election, when none is required due to the number of candidates nominated, would result in an
unnecessary expense to the residents.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
DECEMBER 21, 2010
